name: gpu-vllm-mi300x-2b-q4w4a16
description: Claude Code plugin for the MI300X Gemma 4 E2B 4-bit repack rig: one management skill and one MCP server, both named after the rig directory. Only matters if this rig is published standalone — the marketplace /plugin reads is the monorepo root one.

plugins.name: gpu-vllm-mi300x-2b-q4w4a16
plugins.description: One AMD Instinct MI300X (gfx942, 191.69 GiB) serving xbill9/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct-text — Google's QAT E2B weights repacked to W4A16 without re-rounding — through vLLM on a DigitalOcean GPU droplet reached via AMD Developer Cloud. The 4-bit half of an A/B pair with gpu-vllm-mi300x-2b. Image vetting checks both that the image can load Gemma 4 and that it lists TritonW4A16LinearKernel for ROCm.
